repository.name: GLM-5.2-R9-Adaptive-MTP-FULL-CUDA-4x-DGX-Spark
repository.description: GLM-5.2 on 4x DGX Spark with adaptive MTP K2/K4/K5, FULL CUDA graphs, DCP2, 520K context, and a downloadable ARM64 runtime image.
repository.license: Apache-2.0 (repository material only; see NOTICE.md for the image)

image.local_image_id_note: This is the hash of the image CONFIG, computed locally by the Docker daemon. It is NOT the registry manifest digest and cannot be derived from it.
image.ghcr_digest_note: Assigned by the registry at push time. Fill in from `docker buildx imagetools inspect` after the push; do not compute it locally.
image.archive_parts_note: Five numbered sub-2 GiB GitHub release assets; SHA256SUMS covers every part and the reconstructed archive.
image.recommended_public_repository_note: GHCR mirror not published because the active GitHub CLI token lacks write:packages; the GitHub release archive is the verified public path.

provenance.source_commit_binding_note: Injected at build time as a build arg, because the build stage was a directory rather than a git checkout. It is checkable, not self-certifying: the build script re-hashes the staged recipe files (including its own bytes) before building, a build guard re-hashes the contract that landed in the image, and the script reads the labels back off the finished image afterwards.
provenance.layers_added_note: Inspected output of the build, recorded after the fact. Never asserted in advance.

superseded_build.fate: destroyed by an external fleet-wide docker image prune, 64 seconds after it was built
superseded_build.relationship: This release is a replacement built from a different immediate parent by a different recipe. It is NOT a bit-identical reproduction. The five-file R9 runtime payload is byte-identical; the layer structure and provenance are not.

reconciled_not_verbatim: patches/adaptive-mtp-vllm-hooks.patch: duplicate VLLM_ADAPTIVE_SPEC_DEPTHS parser replaced by one shared parser
patches/adaptive-mtp-vllm-hooks.patch: merged CUDA-graph candidate ranges replaced by layered (prepended) ranges

provenance.publicly_rebuildable_reason: The immediate build parent is a private image that has never been pushed to any registry; the full patch chain 03 -> 06 -> 12 -> 13 that produced it is not published here; and the original R6 base of that chain no longer exists anywhere. See docs/BUILD.md section 4.

runtime.kv_cache_dtype_note: NVFP4 applies to the KV cache, not to the model weights.

measured_results.name: 500k_cold_prompt_c1
measured_results.caveat: One isolated test at concurrency 1 on 4x DGX Spark (GB10, ARM64). Not an across-workload speed claim. Prefill rate is computed KV tokens divided by prefill seconds for this single request, not a sustained throughput figure.

measured_results.name: 500k_telemetry_window
measured_results.acceptance_ratio_denominator: draft tokens actually offered for verification in the window
measured_results.caveat: The controller held K5 throughout this window because tail positions were paying. It is a single 32-step window at 500K context, not a distribution over workloads.

measured_results.name: controller_movement_short_run
measured_results.caveat: Measured over a 3 min 20 s live run on the 550K profile that ended in a host OOM kill unrelated to controller logic. 14.9 percent is a reduction in scheduled draft positions, NOT a decode-speed measurement. No matched K2-vs-K5 decode-rate sample exists.

measured_results.name: graph_capture_cost
measured_results.caveat: Per rank. On unified-memory GB10 nodes with SwapTotal 0 this is the binding constraint; the 550K profile was OOM-killed on the head node under this graph set.

not_established: That adaptive depth is faster than fixed K5 in tokens per second. No valid matched sample exists.
Any general decode-speed figure for this stack.
Any acceptance-rate target (for example >= 92 percent). This build makes such targets measurable; it does not measure them.
Whether the 2/4/5 thresholds, tuned upstream at max_num_seqs=1, behave the same at this deployment's max_num_seqs=3. This is the largest untested assumption.
Any behaviour on hardware other than 4x DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121a, ARM64).

residuals: R-1 internal build hostname, in labels and embedded contract JSON
R-2 three private absolute home paths, in embedded contract JSON
R-3 the owner's first name, once, in embedded contract JSON
